Title: Bound multi-source responses so 'top two link' prompts close with a concise answer.
Description: A fuzzed prompt asking for the top two source links stayed in reasoning for 19 seconds and kept expanding its rationale instead of closing quickly. Add a bounded response strategy for multi-source requests so the model returns a concise answer or an explicit limitation instead of prolonged internal reasoning. Acceptance criteria: multi-source requests complete within a predictable window, the response stays concise, and the trace shows a clear stop condition. Validation: rerun the top-two-links prompt and confirm the assistant finishes without extended reasoning drift.

Comments.Author: AgentSmith
Comments.Body: Evidence: the 2026-05-24 top-two-links probe stayed in reasoning after 19s and was still expanding its response plan, so the issue is not only latency but also finish criteria for multi-source answers.
